name: High Protein Oats
ingredients: Instant Oats (52.7%), Protein Blend (27.6%) (Texturised Soy Protein Flakes, Whey Powder), Dehydrated Fruits, Nuts & Seeds (10%) (Raisins, Sunflower Seeds, Chia Seeds, Pumpkin Seeds, Almonds), Fructo-Oligosaccharide, Rice Bran Oil, Natural Flavour, Himalayan Pink Salt, Beta Carotenes, Steviol Glycosides, Bacillus Coagulans
